newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens mixed, market awaits CBI survey.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens mixed, market awaits CBI survey.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index of leading shares opened mixed on Thursday, lacking guidance from international markets, dealers and strategists said.

The index bobbed about last night's close and was 0.9 points off at 4,873.6 by 0746 GMT. The Dow ended 26.71 points ahead, after an early 85-point advance, shedding about ten points of the gain seen at the London close.
"It's hardly an exciting background," said NatWest equities strategist, David McBain.
"We're in a consolidation period and a less than dramatic close on Wall Street has set a somewhat dull tone," he said.
